name: Khaman
ingredients: 1 teaspoon citric acid or lemon juice
instructions: 1. Whisk gram flour, yogurt, turmeric, salt, sugar, and water to create a smooth batter.
2. Add the ginger-green chili paste and citric acid, mixing thoroughly.
3. Just before steaming, add fruit salt (Eno) and a splash of water to activate the bubbles, then fold gently.
4. Pour the batter into a greased steaming tray and steam for 15-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
6. For the tempering, heat oil in a small pan, add mustard seeds, sesame seeds, and green chilies, then pour this mixture over the steamed squares along with a little sugar water.
7. Garnish with fresh coriander and grated coconut.
description: Khaman is a quintessentially Gujarati snack, beloved for its soft, spongy texture and balance of sweet, tangy, and savory flavors. It is a staple at breakfast or tea time and represents the diverse vegetarian culinary heritage of Gujarat.
